# OneLi8 Design System — 1.0.0-beta.10

Headless, vanilla HTML/CSS/JS design system synced from Figma.
Figma file: 0wRnp6ulIEA8PCV6wqGmAJ
  https://www.figma.com/design/0wRnp6ulIEA8PCV6wqGmAJ/
  The file title is deliberately NOT cited with a version. The plugin API cannot read the
  file title (figma.root.name returns "Document") and cannot set it, so a version written
  here could never be gated and would rot at the next release. The package version above
  is the single source of truth for which release this is.

## Rules for AI agents

1. Token prefix is `--ol8-`. Never emit a literal color, size, or font value.
2. Read `ai-context.json` before generating any component markup.
3. Resolve a component in this order:
   a. pick `footprint.element`
   b. apply `baseClass` + `footprint` required attributes
   c. for each Figma variant axis, look up the value and apply `emit` per its `strategy`
      - `strategy: "pseudo"` and `strategy: "inherit"` emit NOTHING
      - `strategy: "conditional-attribute"` branches on the element from (a)
   d. apply `a11y.invariants`
   e. self-check the result against every `forbid` pattern before returning
4. Never invent a variant value. The values in `ai-context.json` are the complete set.

## Figma property -> code attribute

| Figma                       | Code                                    |
|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| Component name `Icon / X / Y` | `data-ol8-icon="<kebab y>"`           |
| `Size` (Icon Frame)         | `data-ol8-icon-size="<9…108>"`          |
| Semantic color              | inherited `color` — never set on icon   |
| RTL mirroring registry      | `data-ol8-icon-mirror="true"`           |

## Packages

- `packages/tokens` — `src/{primitive,semantic,themes}.json` -> `build/css/tokens.css`
  (`--ol8-*`) + `build/typescript/index.js` + `build/tailwind/preset.mjs`
- `packages/core`   — headless components, buildless ESM + `.d.ts`, no bundler
  - `src/atoms/`     compose nothing; native elements only
  - `src/molecules/` composed of atoms
  - `src/organisms/` composed of atoms/molecules; may hold state and logic
  - `src/materials/` NOT a tier — cross-cutting surface adapters (gem)
- `packages/sync`   — Figma extraction, normalization, and structure lint

## Gem material rules

Gem has two faces and they imply different content. Choosing the wrong pairing is
the most common Gem error, in both directions.

- `material.gem.color.quiet.environmentalFace` — a surface over imagery or the
  real world. Content is `material.gem.color.quiet.content`, a stable near-white
  in BOTH appearances, carrying the `quiet.contentGlow` halo at
  `material.gem.blur.contentGlow`: four stacked shadows for text, three for
  control geometry, because 1.4.11 asks 3:1 of a graphical object where 1.4.3
  asks 4.5:1 of text. Content means every glyph AND the unselected control
  boundary AND any icon, never the label alone.
- `material.gem.color.quiet.stabilizedFace` — app chrome, including the filled
  Gem text field, Select and Combobox. Content is ordinary `color.text.*`, no
  halo.
- `material.gem.color.quiet.legibilityFace` — the reduced-transparency mode.
  Denser, NEVER opaque: Gem is worn, so a solid surface would occlude the
  world for the person who needs help reading it.
- Disabled takes `material.gem.color.quiet.contentDisabled`, one whitish grey
  shared by text and control geometry, and no halo. It is a STATE, not a
  material change: the body and backdrop blur stay, only the lit bezel goes.
  Loading is an ACTIVE state and keeps the bezel.
- On a button the label and the icon always take the same value. `--_fg` is the
  label, `--_ink` is the icon, and every Gem rule sets them together.
- Never thicken a face to win contrast and never widen the halo: blur spreads a
  fixed alpha budget, so a wider halo is a WEAKER halo.

`docs/gem-material.md` carries the measured values and the Figma node each was
read from.

## Structural rules (enforced by `npm run check`)

- Assign margins to a component via its PARENT, never the component itself.
- Atoms must not import from molecules or organisms.

## Foundations (page 9:7) — complete

606 CSS custom properties in `packages/tokens/build/css/tokens.css`:
170 primitives, 275 semantic roles, 17 dimension steps (3px-atomic),
9 radii, 9 typography roles, 5 elevations.

- Consume SEMANTIC roles only. Primitives are hidden from Figma pickers.
- `--ol8-color-primary-*` aliases `--ol8-color-blue-*`; prefer the semantic role.
- Typography roles are composite. Apply all five of `--ol8-typography-<role>-{font-family,font-size,font-weight,line-height,letter-spacing}` together. There are no class names in this package.
- Elevation ink is cyan-840 `rgb(22,63,75)`, never black.

## Status

- [x] Foundations — 337 tokens. Verified in-browser, 0 unresolved, 0 mismatches.
- [x] `ol8-icon` — 17 masters (14 neutral + 3 selection), 11 universal sizes.
- [x] `ol8-btn` — 4 families x 4 sizes, all 6 states. Verified in-browser.
- [x] `ol8-icon-btn` — 4 families x 2 shapes x 4 sizes, all 6 states.
- [x] Gem material — Primary + Secondary, Button and Icon Button.
- [x] `ol8-selection` (atom) — checkbox, radio, switch indicators.
- [x] `ol8-choice` (molecule) — Choice Item, 56 variants.
- [x] `ol8-choice-group` (organism) — checkbox hierarchy + radio group.

## Choice Controls rules

Aggregate (none/some/all) is COMPUTED from children and never authored.
Mixed is never a third preference: clicking a Mixed parent resolves the whole
subtree to checked. A native radio group already gives arrow-key roving focus
and single selection — do not reimplement them.

## Gem material

`data-ol8-material="gem"` on an existing button. NOT a variant, NOT a class.
Approved for primary and secondary only; quiet and destructive stay regular.
Gradient is `to bottom right` — that is exactly Figma's baked per-size angle
(theta = 90deg + atan(W/H)), and unlike a baked degree it stays correct at any
label width. Reduced Transparency hides the gem layers and the regular opaque
button shows through.

## Button rules

The six Figma States are NOT six markup variants:
Default -> base | Hover -> :hover | Pressed -> :active / [aria-pressed]
Focus -> :focus-visible | Disabled -> [disabled] | Loading -> [data-ol8-loading]

`.ol8-btn--hover` and friends are bugs. Secondary vs Quiet differ ONLY by
`--ol8-component-button-secondaryboundary` (2px); their colors are identical.
